title: Deep Double Q-learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.00275v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Double Q-learning is a classical control algorithm that mitigates the maximization bias of Q-learning. To do so, it explicitly trains two independent action-value functions and uses them to decouple action-selection from action-evaluation when computing bootstrap targets. Double DQN adapts this decoupling to deep reinforcement learning (RL) but directly trains only a single action-value function and does not fully decouple its estimators. Consequently, the two estimators remain correlated, and overestimation persists. In this paper, we introduce Deep Double Q-learning (DDQL), a deep RL algorithm that explicitly trains two Q-functions through the Double Q-learning objective. DDQL stabilizes training through a combination of techniques, including lower replay ratios, longer target network update intervals, and shared layers. translated_title: 深度双重Q学习（Deep Double Q-learning）
translated_abstract: 双重Q学习（Double Q-learning）是一种经典控制算法，用于缓解Q学习的最大化偏差。为此，它显式地训练两个独立的动作值函数，并在计算自举目标时利用它们将动作选择与动作评估解耦。Double DQN 将这种解耦思想应用于深度强化学习（RL），但它只直接训练单个动作值函数，并未完全解耦其估计器。因此，这两个估计器之间仍然存在相关性，高估问题依然存在。本文提出了深度双重Q学习（DDQL），这是一种通过双重Q学习目标显式训练两个Q函数的深度强化学习算法。DDQL 通过多种技术组合来稳定训练，包括较低的经验回放比率、更长的目标网络更新间隔以及共享层。在57个Atari 2600游戏中，DDQL 的总体性能优于 Double DQN，在47个游戏上超越了它（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出深度双重Q学习（DDQL），通过双重Q学习目标显式训练两个Q函数实现估计器解耦，并借助较低回放比率、更长目标网络更新间隔和共享层等技术稳定训练，在57个Atari游戏上总体性能超越Double DQN。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Deep Double Q-learning (DDQL), which explicitly trains two Q-functions via the Double Q-learning objective to fully decouple estimators, and stabilizes training with lower replay ratios, longer target network update intervals, and shared layers, achieving better aggregate performance than Double DQN across 57 Atari games.
